title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Ireland's inclusive education programme in Senegal operates in Dakar and six regions (Kaolack, Dakar, Kaffrine, Kolda, Sédhiou, and Louga), aiming to enrol 2,289 children with disabilities in primary and 864 in secondary education. We target 36 ministries and departments to enhance inclusive education capacity, focusing on the specific, gender specific needs of girls and boys with disabilities. Key activities include advocating for local councils to incorporate disability-inclusive activities into their education budgets; and supporting the Ministry of National Education to finalise the Inclusive Education policy, and supporting 70 schools in collecting gender-disaggregated data on students with disabilities. The overall aim of the project is to ensure that children with disabilities receive quality inclusive education. The project aims to ensure that equal numbers of boys and girls are enrolled.
